item.title: Xbox has new management, but not a lot of options
item.description: It's too late to change most of the decisions that led Microsoft here. So what now?

item.title: Don't wait two years like me, you need Bazzite on your Asus ROG Ally right now
item.description: Pocket Tactics writes: "I finally made the move to install Bazzite on my ROG Ally recently, and I can't imagine playing this Steam Deck rival without it going forward."

item.title: Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter Golden Wings Edition announced
item.description: GungHo Online Entertainment has announced the opening pre-orders for the Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter Golden Wings Edition, a premium collectors edition priced at $274.99 for PlayStation 5, Switch, and PC, and $279.99 for Switch 2. Pre-orders will be available via Panax Store by PM Studios until March 8.

item.title: Panzer Knights: Commanders Edition announced for PS5, Xbox Series
item.description: Publisher PQube and developer Joy Brick have announced anime-inspired tank simulation game Panzer Knights: Commanders Edition for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series. It will launch in 2026. A physical edition will be available for PlayStation 5.

item.title: Another first-party Nintendo Switch games sale has gone live
item.description: Another new first-party Nintendo Switch game sale is happening, including Super Mario Odyssey, Donkey Kong, Luigi's Mansion 2 HD, and more.

item.title: The fast-paced FPS roguelite, Galactic Vault, is coming to Steam on March 10th
item.description: "Belgian Indie studio MeepMeep Games squeezed the trigger to announce that their debut title, Galactic Vault, will launch on PC (Steam) on March 10, 2026." - MeepMeep Games.

item.title: The ambient idle game, Cozywood Creek, is coming to PC via Steam in Q2 2026
item.description: "The indie games developer Silver Bullet, are today very happy to announce that their ambient idle game, Cozywood Creek, is coming to PC via Steam in Q2 2026." - Silver Bullet.

item.title: The action, adventure/RTS, Rise of Piracy, is now available via Steam EA
item.description: "MicroProse and Spideog Studios are today very happy to announce that their action, adventure/RTS, Rise of Piracy, is now available via Steam Early Access.." - MicroProse and Spideog Studios.

item.title: The story-rich adventure, Apopia: Sugar Coated Tale, is coming to Steam on March 3rd
item.description: "Independent publisher Happinet is excited to share that its story-rich adventure title Apopia: Sugar Coated Tale will release on PC via Steam on March 3, 2026." - Happinet.

item.title: Horizon Hunters Gathering Closed Playtest Announced for PS5 and Steam
item.description: Horizon Hunters Gathering closed playtest runs February 27 to March 1 on PS5 and Steam, with beta invites now being sent to selected players.
